newsitem.title: USA: Country singer Faron Young rebuffs son in will.
newsitem.headline: Country singer Faron Young rebuffs son in will.

text.p: Country singer Faron Young, who committed suicide last week, left $200,000 each to three of his children but only $1 to his son Robyn, who testified against him in a divorce trial.
Young's will, filed for probate by his accountant, showed the singer-songwriter also left $50,000 to a daughter, Farianne Moore, whom he had acknowledged as his child born out of wedlock.

Robyn Young, 39, said he never regretted testifying for his mother, Hilda Young, in the divorce action 10 years ago and that he had "no hard feelings" toward his father. Last Saturday night he sang "Hello, Walls," his father's top recording, as a tribute on the Grand Ole Opry broadcast.
